q1: SELECT NAME AS CUSTOMERS FROM CUSTOMERS WHERE ID NOT IN (SELECT CUSTOMERID FROM ORDERS)
q2: SELECT NAME AS CUSTOMERS FROM CUSTOMERS WHERE (ID NOT IN (SELECT CUSTOMERID FROM ORDERS))
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT NAME AS CUSTOMERS FROM CUSTOMERS WHERE ID NOT IN (SELECT CUSTOMERID FROM ORDERS)
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT NAME AS CUSTOMERS FROM CUSTOMERS WHERE (ID NOT IN (SELECT CUSTOMERID FROM ORDERS))
explanation: Both Q1 and Q2 are semantically equivalent. They both aim to select the names of customers who do not have any orders. The parentheses in Q2 do not change the logic, as the NOT IN subquery is the only part of the WHERE clause.
